verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is not itself an AI coding agent but a background-jobs/agent-building platform, so the MCP-server axis applies directly, and it documents an official MCP server enabling AI assistants to interact with Trigger.dev projects, including tools for Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf to converse with chat agents and manage tasks without code. This is corroborated by a dedicated probe confirming the server's existence. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of the MCP server itself (community evidence is about the core platform, not MCP usage specifically).
